description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of emotional categories in a dataset used for evaluating speaker anonymization on emotional speech, with each slice representing a distinct emotion and its corresponding proportion of the total. The chart is divided into six labeled segments: "Frustration" (25.1%, light blue), "Neutral" (23.1%, dark blue), "Happiness" (8.1%, light purple), "Excitement" (14.1%, red), "Sadness" (14.7%, brown), and "Anger" (14.9%, yellow). Each segment is clearly labeled with its emotional category and percentage value, and the slices are arranged in a clockwise direction starting from the top right, with the largest proportions, "Frustration" and "Neutral," positioned at the top. The colors are distinct and help differentiate the categories, and the percentages are explicitly shown within each slice, allowing for direct comparison of the emotional distribution.
